comparison.objective: Stack three smooth pipes lengthwise on a narrow pad after chocking the bottom pair.
comparison.physical_skill: Unstable cylindrical-object placement and chock use, without precision impact tooling.
comparison.success_condition: Three pipes form the intended supported stack on the pad; stability duration and detailed thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests gravity stabilization and stacking of rolling objects rather than localized fracture and debris containment.
